findings.title: Hardcoded session secret fallback
findings.description: signToken and verifyToken fall back to 'dev-secret-change-me' if SESSION_SECRET env var is unset. This secret is visible in the public GitHub repo.
findings.exploit_scenario: 1. Attacker reads public source code, sees fallback secret. 2. If app deployed without SESSION_SECRET set, attacker forges valid session token for any userId. 3. Complete account takeover.
findings.impact: Complete account takeover for any user if env var is missing
findings.recommendation: Throw error if SESSION_SECRET is not set. Never fallback to hardcoded value.

findings.title: HMAC comparison not timing-safe
findings.description: verifyToken uses !== for HMAC comparison instead of crypto.timingSafeEqual. Same file uses timingSafeEqual for password verification.
findings.exploit_scenario: 1. Attacker sends crafted session cookies measuring response time. 2. Byte-by-byte determines correct HMAC. 3. Forges valid session token.
findings.impact: Session token forgery via timing side-channel

findings.title: No cost cap on AI chat API calls
findings.description: AI chat endpoint allows unlimited requests with up to 5 tool-use iterations each. No per-user or per-day limits.
findings.exploit_scenario: 1. Authenticated user scripts rapid-fire chat requests. 2. Each triggers 1-5 Anthropic API calls. 3. Runs up Anthropic bill without throttle.
findings.recommendation: Add per-user daily message limits (e.g., 100/day tracked in DB)
